# Indoor Cliff Diving

> Indoor Cliff Diving is a sports club in Amsterdam offering cliff diving, high diving, X-diving and freestyle diving in the diving tower pool at Sloterparkbad, with training for all levels from 0 to 10 metres. Training runs year-round at Sloterparkbad in Amsterdam Nieuw-West, with Skill Classes led by a trainer and Open Trainings for independent practice. Sessions start at €15 and no prior experience is required.

Indoor Cliff Diving is a sports club, not a shop. The live class schedule, reservations and ticket sales are all handled by an external system at https://indoorcliffdiving.trainin.app/company/schedule. The website itself is a single informational page published in Dutch and English.

- Address: Optisport Sloterparkbad, President Allendelaan 3, 1064 GW Amsterdam, Netherlands
- Coordinates: 52.3697, 4.8178
- Email: indoorcliffdiving@gmail.com
- Phone: +31627126225
- Founded: 2017

## Pages

- [Indoor Cliff Diving (Dutch)](https://www.indoorcliffdiving.com/): Full site in Dutch — training times, services, event calendar, prices, team, contact details and FAQ.
- [Indoor Cliff Diving (English)](https://www.indoorcliffdiving.com/en.html): The same content in English.
- [Full site content as text](https://www.indoorcliffdiving.com/llms-full.txt): Every fact on the site — schedule, prices, services, FAQ and the current event calendar — as plain text.

## Booking and schedule

- [Book a session](https://indoorcliffdiving.trainin.app/company/schedule): Live class schedule and reservations.
- [Buy tickets and memberships](https://indoorcliffdiving.trainin.app/company/shop): Single entries, packages, monthly and season passes.
- [Class timetable](https://indoorcliffdiving.trainin.app/schedule): Skill Classes and Open Trainings.
